issues.description: validate_conda substring match accepts any binary whose --version output contains 'conda'/'mamba'.
issues.detail: any(tool in out.decode().lower() ...) over ['micromamba','mamba','conda'] matches substrings anywhere in the output, so 'anaconda-client', paths like /opt/anaconda/bin/foo, or unrelated tools pass. Check the leading token of the version string or the basename instead of doing membership in arbitrary output.

issues.description: filters='*.exe' on the file picker is Windows-only and breaks Linux/macOS users.
issues.detail: conda/mamba/micromamba are extensionless on macOS and Linux, so the dialog hides them by default and forces users to defeat the filter. This is a platform assumption leaking into a cross-platform config. Either gate the filter on sys.platform or drop it.

issues.description: validate_conda returns True for empty string, conflating 'unset' with 'verified executable'.
issues.detail: The function lies about its postcondition to accommodate the empty-textbox UI case. Downstream callers cannot trust True to mean 'this is a working conda binary'. Separate the emptiness check from validity, or have the UI layer interpret empty as unset.

issues.description: Redundant 'custom_conda' boolean complects override decision already carried by 'conda_path'.
issues.detail: argv() now has three sources of truth: auto-discovery, the custom_conda boolean, and the conda_path string. The boolean adds no information the path doesn't carry, and the kernelspec fallback consumes the configured path without re-validating at use time. Drop the boolean and treat a non-empty conda_path as the override.

issues.description: setFocus() side effect added to shared create_browsefile helper changes behavior for every caller.
issues.detail: create_browsefile is shared infrastructure used across preference pages. Calling edit.setFocus() after select_file silently alters focus behavior for every existing caller because of one new conda field. Move the focus call to the conda-specific caller, not the shared widget helper.

issues.description: run_program subprocess in validate_conda has no timeout and leaks process handle.
issues.detail: run_program(...).communicate() blocks the preferences UI thread with no timeout, kill, or context manager, so a hung or misidentified binary will freeze the dialog. Pipes are not explicitly closed, leaking file descriptors over live validation as the user types. Bind the handle, add a timeout, and let it close cleanly.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR is well-scoped and useful but ships with a sloppy validator and a platform-incorrect file filter. validate_conda uses substring matching that admits false positives, returns True for empty input (conflating unset with valid), and runs an untimed subprocess that can hang the UI. The '*.exe' filter breaks Linux/macOS users by default. The kernelspec path carries a redundant custom_conda boolean alongside conda_path, and a setFocus side effect was added to a shared widget helper. NEEDS-WORK: tighten the validator, platform-gate or drop the filter, simplify the config to one source of truth, and move the focus call to the caller.
